recognize_zh: 流式散點圖顯示主要族群落在 CD20+/CD23+ 象限（第 2 象限），CD23 明顯陽性而 CD20 僅中低強度（dim），這種 CD23 陽性、CD20 弱表現正是 CLL 與被套細胞淋巴瘤區分的重點。
features: Single two-parameter dot plot of CD23-PE (y-axis) versus CD20-PECy5 (x-axis)
Dominant population in quadrant 2, co-expressing CD23 and CD20
CD20 expression is moderate/dim, not reaching the bright upper range
CD23 expression is uniformly positive across the population
Minor double-negative events in quadrant 3 represent non-B cells
describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plot shows a dominant B-cell population uniformly positive for CD23 with dim to moderate CD20 expression (quadrant 2), with a minor double-negative population representing non-B cells. Combined with CD5 co-expression and CD10 negativity, this immunophenotype supports chronic lymphocytic leukemia (Matutes score features include CD23 positivity and weak CD20/surface immunoglobulin). Light-chain restriction is not displayed in this figure.

ddx.vs: Usually CD23-negative or dim with bright CD20 and surface Ig, and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
Shows bright CD20 with CD11c, CD25, CD103 and CD123 positivity and is CD23-negative.
Typically bright CD20 and CD5-negative, with variable weak CD23.
